property.statement: For the bounded default-production, owner-built NCM data-only request path, the same canonical prepared request is assessed by the N5 owner before grounded candidate selection. A high-ranked candidate with contradictory direct assignments is retained with typed ineligible reason intervention_assignment_conflict and excluded; a lower-ranked single-atom candidate is eligible, selected, run, persisted to CAS, loaded by identity, and read by a fresh N8 process.
runtime_path: JointSimulationPort execution revalidating the prepared request

property.proxy_divergence: Ranking-only selection prefers candidate_high_conflict (score 0.99, VOI estimate 20.0) over candidate_feasible_single (score 0.90, VOI estimate 8.0). The owner check detects the high candidate’s same-slot incompatible writes and admits the lower candidate. The removal probe keeps the refusal marker but removes the selector applicability map; selection changes back to the high candidate, demonstrating marker presence is not the property.
negative_controls: All candidates conflicting: typed ineligible summaries remain; cycle is simulation_blocked; simulation result is absent; VOI action is not_run_hard_feasibility_blocked; N5 run call count is zero.
Removal probe: preserve high-candidate ineligible marker, remove only the selector applicability map; the high candidate is selected and no N5 result is created.
Prepared digest: mutate candidate atom or problem runtime hints after preparation; currentness check refuses. A profile-handoff path does not claim support for this preflight.
Opaque live engine-plan state is rejected as not_established; finite Decimal values are typed in the request digest, while NaN and infinities are rejected.
property.persisted_result_checks: The selected result receipt is loaded from CAS and bound to WMR identity/content, atom IDs, requested outcome and payload receipt. The test compares stored engine decisions and trajectories with a second call to the same internal N5 controller runner. A separate N8 process reads the CAS-backed result reference and remains value_conditional with simulation_only_k_sim_not_world_evidence authority blocker.
property.authority_purpose: Shadow research simulation only. The candidate remains non-promotable; the fresh N8 consumer explicitly retains the simulation-only authority blocker.
property.surface: The bounded outcome is exposed on typed GenerationCycleRun candidate summaries and the cycle selection/simulation result. This slice does not establish a new external API or audit endpoint contract for this field.

The typed refusal is asserted on the returned GenerationCycleRun candidate summaries; this slice does not prove a separate durable/audit rejection artifact or summary round-trip.
